title: Navnirman-e-Bharat Youth Parliament: The Delhi Edition
subtitle: नवनिर्माण-ए-भारत
summary: A two-day Youth Parliament organised by Shubhkant Foundation at the NDMC Convention Centre, New Delhi, with 300+ students and young participants.
description: A two-day Youth Parliament organised by Shubhkant Foundation on 16 and 17 November 2026 at the NDMC Convention Centre, New Delhi.
More than 300 students and young participants took part in parliamentary sessions focused on the implementation of 33% reservation for women in legislatures.

summary: The Delhi Edition of the Navnirman-e-Bharat Youth Parliament brought together more than 300 students and young participants at the NDMC Convention Centre, New Delhi, on 16 and 17 November 2026.
Participants took part in parliamentary discussions on the implementation of 33% reservation for women in legislatures, along with delimitation and balanced representation.
Shri Manoj Tiwari, MP, addressed the participants through a video message and spoke about the importance of understanding parliamentary rules and procedures.

title: BANA DAAL
summary: A flagship event under Shubhkant Foundation that brings together aspiring entrepreneurs, young minds and visionary thinkers to turn potential into progress.
description: BANA DAAL is a flagship event organised under the auspices of Shubhkant Foundation. Conceived as a platform for innovation, learning and leadership, it brings together aspiring entrepreneurs, young minds and visionary thinkers to turn potential into progress.
highlights: Linking aspiring entrepreneurs, student innovators and startup founders with industry professionals, experienced mentors and potential investors.
Panel discussions and interactive sessions on business strategies, sustainable growth, funding awareness and technological innovation.
Pitching opportunities, practical learning and expert feedback.
Networking, interdisciplinary partnerships and professional relationships.
